headline: Passage Falls as Nevish Line Rekindles
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition Callahan's Passage has gone wholly to Warden hands at ten to none, with three changes in two hours and twenty-three on the day about the Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post amid 5,642 Colonial and 5,581 Warden casualties and quickening rates; the Nevish Line has stirred anew after quiet hours to seven Warden to one Colonial with six changes in two hours and twenty on the day about Blackcoat Way and Princefal amid 5,251 and 5,740 lost. The Weathered Expanse now stands one Warden, four Colonial and four in ruins after two changes in two hours and eighty-eight on the day centred on Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance with 7,532 and 10,342 lost and rates still quickening, while Mooring County holds ten to two without a change in two hours after forty-eight on the day about Gravekeeper's Holdfast and MacConmara Barrows with 6,575 and 5,899 lost. Gutter shows six changes at Kuoppa and Marban Hollow two at Mox, as Palantine Berm, Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row record no change in six hours.
